required_fields.label: Project name
required_fields.placeholder: e.g., Nashua Elm/High Street Parking Garages — Inductive Loop Installation

required_fields.label: Inspector (name, title, credentials)
required_fields.placeholder: e.g., Jonathan Sargent — Principal / QC Inspector; MA LV (Class C); OSHA-30

required_fields.label: Reference documents / standards
required_fields.placeholder: SOW §, drawings, FHWA handbook, prior QC reports ...

required_fields.label: Completion / pass statement
required_fields.placeholder: e.g., All 19 inductive loops verified PASS per acceptance criteria

required_fields.label: Acceptance criteria (one per line: Test | Pass | Marginal | Fail)
required_fields.placeholder:
Continuity | Closed circuit | — | Open circuit
DC Resistance | < 5 Ω | 5–8 Ω | > 8 Ω

required_fields.label: Test results (one per line: ID | Location | + your measured columns | Result)
required_fields.placeholder: P1-L1 | Plaza 1 — Garden St S | Closed | ~3 Ω | ~124 MΩ | PASS

optional_fields.label: Test instruments (one per line: Instrument | Purpose)
optional_fields.placeholder:
Digital Ohmmeter | Continuity + DC resistance
Megohmmeter | Insulation resistance to ground

optional_fields.label: Quality summary (one per line: Group | Quantity | Status)
Final QC notes (one per line)
optional_fields.placeholder: Readings clustered; no deviations from SOW; scope handoff notes ...

file_upload_prompts.label: Upload SOW, acceptance standards, or raw test logs

sections.label: Report Details
sections.instructions: ONLY a two-column markdown table: Project, Job #, Project Period, Report Date, Inspector, Reference. No prose.

sections.label: Project Completion
sections.instructions: One short emphasized paragraph stating the overall pass/completion result from completion_statement. No table, no fabricated counts beyond what is provided.

sections.label: Acceptance Criteria
sections.instructions: A markdown table with columns: Test | Pass | Marginal / Review | Fail, one row per criterion from the acceptance_criteria field (pipe-delimited). Use '—' for empty cells. Reproduce thresholds exactly as provided.

sections.label: Test Instruments
sections.instructions: A markdown table: Instrument | Purpose, from the field. Omit the section if not provided.

sections.label: Final Test Results
sections.instructions: A markdown table whose columns match the header of the test_results field (e.g., ID | Location | Continuity | DC Resistance | Insulation R | Result), one row per item. Right-align numeric/measurement columns. Reproduce every value exactly; never invent a reading. Below the table, one line stating overall pass.

sections.label: Project Quality Summary
sections.instructions: A markdown table: Group | Quantity | Status from quality_summary, plus a TOTAL row. Omit if not provided.

sections.label: Final QC Notes
sections.instructions: A tight bullet list of QC notes. Omit if none provided.

sections.label: Final QC Report Prepared and Certified By
sections.instructions: The certifying inspector block from inspector: name, title, credentials each on its own line, then 'Signature & Date'.
